transcript:
**Agent:** Thank you for calling Tech Solutions Support. This is Rachel speaking. How can I assist you today?

**Customer:** Hi Rachel, I’m really frustrated. I just got charged for the Pro plan, but I never intended to upgrade. 

**Agent:** I’m sorry to hear that! Let’s take a look at your account and see what happened. Can I have your email address associated with the account, please?

**Customer:** Sure, it's johndoe@example.com.

**Agent:** Thank you, John. Just a moment while I pull up your information. *[pause]* It looks like you were on the Basic plan, but there was an automatic upgrade due to an expiration of a promotional offer. 

**Customer:** I didn’t receive any notifications about that! I would have preferred to stay on the Basic plan. 

**Agent:** I completely understand how that can be frustrating. I can help you downgrade back to the Basic plan and process a refund for the recent charge. 

**Customer:** That would be great, thank you! How long will it take for the refund to show up?

**Agent:** The refund typically takes 3-5 business days to reflect in your account. I can initiate that right now. 

**Customer:** Perfect! And just to confirm, what features do I lose if I downgrade?

**Agent:** You’ll lose access to advanced analytics and priority customer support, but you’ll still have all the essential features that the Basic plan offers. 

**Customer:** Alright, that makes sense. I appreciate your help with all of this.

**Agent:** You’re very welcome! I’ll get those changes implemented right away. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?

**Customer:** No, that’s it for now. Thank you again for your assistance!

**Agent:** My pleasure, John! If you have any further questions, don’t hesitate to reach out. Have a great day!
